headline: Small short-period S — a soft, glassy dawn at best.
today: Around a foot and a half of short-period S on a fair angle, so nothing with much punch. Morning is light-to-offshore and glassy, so log the incoming early before the SSE-S cross-on and onshore take over by afternoon. Low-priority day.

daysToWatch.note: S swell jumps toward 4ft-plus but it's short-period on a fair angle and dawn is a 17mph cross-on. Afternoon NE goes cross-off and evening N offshore — that's the cleanup window if the size lingers.
Fun morning: S to nearly 3ft with N offshore and cross-off before the afternoon onshore. Short-period and soft but worth a session. Go early.
Prime ESE angle with glassy light wind all day, but the swell's only knee-high. Clean and mellow — log it if you want easy waves.
